name: Darkrider extends the duration of Mark spells by 50% (#2466)
contract: Darkrider 704980 reads 'Increases the duration of your Mark spells by 50% and increases your spell penetration by 75, scaling with level' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z; matches the client's own moa_description). Mark(SpellInfo const*) (promoted from AscensionXorothAuras.cpp to the shared AscensionXoroth.h/.cpp) identifies a family-23 spell by SpellFamilyFlags[1] bit 2147483648, which every Mark of Korth'azz/Blaumeux/Rivendare/Zeliek rank and its Greater form carries. Darkrider's own baked EFFECT_1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION, correctly classmasked to that same bit, BasePoints 49/DieSides 1 -> 50) relies on Aura::CalcMaxDuration's native modOwner->ApplySpellMod pass, but this module's own triggered Mark applications do not reliably reach that native path, so it is nulled in ApplyContracts; xoroth_casts::OnCalcMaxDuration (AscensionXorothAbilities.cpp) now multiplies the duration by 1 + Amount(704980, 1)/100 directly whenever the caster knows the talent and the aura being created is a Mark. Effect 2 (spell penetration) is out of this issue's reported scope and is untouched. At level 60 the owned Mark of Korth'azz rank is 707345 (AscensionSpellProgressionData.h). HARNESS NOTE: Mark of Korth'azz is TARGET_FLAG_UNIT_ENEMY-only and this harness has no reliable way to make one player a valid open-world attack target of another for an arbitrary custom-class spell (pvp-flagging two opposite-faction actors and placing them in a shared coordinate still yields SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS for this particular spell's target check, even though a plain melee attack between the same two actors is accepted as a valid attack target). OnCalcMaxDuration's gate is purely on the aura's caster (Owner(aura->GetCaster())->HasAura(704980)), not on who carries the aura, so the fix is exercised just as faithfully by forcing the Mark onto the knight itself with set_aura (which creates the Aura directly via Unit::AddAura, bypassing spell-cast target validation entirely while still running the native CalcMaxDuration -> OnCalcMaxDuration pipeline).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Force the Mark onto the knight, without Darkrider
SETUP: the Mark is active without Darkrider
SETUP: the untalented Mark actually has a positive duration
Clear the Mark so the next application recalculates its duration from scratch
Force the Mark onto the knight again, now with Darkrider known
SETUP: the Mark is active with Darkrider known
CONTRACT: the talented Mark's duration is ~50% longer
